name: Standard Batteries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1945, Standard Batteries Ltd is in the business of dealing in steel and metals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company used to manufacture lead acid batteries for industrial & automotive use but exited this business in FY98 and since then, company is engaged in trading of various goods. It is also in the business of Financial Services including providing loans to corporates, bills discounting and factoring

cons: Stock is trading at 11.2 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -90.4% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 84.3% of their holding.
